context_pill: Classification of Agricultural and Special Exempt Incomes
example_summary: Examining the taxability of rent from agricultural land buildings, nursery seedlings income, and a Sikkimese individual's receipts under the Act.
source_provision:
| Category / Issue | Statutory Section & Rule | Key Conditions & Thresholds | Tax Treatment & Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Agricultural Income** | Section 10(1) r/w Section 2(1A) | Revenue derived from land situated in India and used for agricultural operations. | **Exempt** from total income.

| **Non-Agricultural Building** | Section 2(1A) Explanation 2 | Building letting out for residential, business, or professional use other than agriculture. | **Taxable** as business income or income from house property.

| **Nursery Seedlings** | Section 2(1A) Explanation 3 | Income derived from saplings or seedlings grown in a nursery. | **Exempt** (deemed agricultural income even if basic operations are absent).

| **Sikkimese Individual** | Section 10(26AAA) | Income accruing/arising to a Sikkimese individual from any source in Sikkim or dividend/interest on securities. | **Exempt** from income tax.


> [!IMPORTANT]
> Building Let-Out Test: Letting out agricultural land buildings for residential purposes to industrial workers violates Explanation 2 to Section 2(1A) and forfeits agricultural exemption.


> [!WARNING]
> Nursery Exception: Unlike general agriculture, growing seedlings in nurseries does not require basic operations on land to qualify for Section 10(1) exemption u/s 2(1A) Explanation 3.

director.justification: The scenarios require applying specific statutory definitions and explanations to classify income as either exempt agricultural income or taxable income based on usage, operations, and regional status.
director.visual_metaphor: A Taxability Sieve sorting income into 'Exempt' and 'Taxable' buckets based on statutory filters.

Apply the building use test for agricultural land rent

title.text: Building Use Test for Agricultural Land Rent

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 10(1) പ്രകാരം agricultural income പൂർണ്ണമായും exempt ആണ്. ഇതിന്റെ definition Section 2(1A)-ൽ നൽകിയിരിക്കുന്നു. എന്നാൽ Explanation 2 to Section 2(1A) അനുസരിച്ച്, agricultural land-ലെ building industrial workers-ന് residential purposes-നായി let out ചെയ്താൽ അത് agricultural income അല്ല. അത് chargeable to tax ആണ്.

branches.label: Chargeable to tax
branches.detail: Not agricultural income, rent of 60,000 is taxable

beats.director_goal: Apply the building use test for agricultural land rent

beats.voice_sync_text: Explanation 3 to Section 2(1A) പ്രകാരം nursery-യിൽ seedlings വളർത്തി വിൽക്കുന്ന income deemed agricultural income ആണ്. അതിന് basic operations land-ൽ ചെയ്യണം എന്നില്ല. അതിനാൽ 75,000 ലഭിച്ച income exempt ആണ്.
beats.director_goal: Explain the nursery seedling exception to basic operations

beats.voice_sync_text: അതുപോലെ Section 10(26AAA) പ്രകാരം Sikkimese individual-ന് Sikkim-ൽ നിന്ന് ലഭിക്കുന്ന income ഉം interest on securities എന്നിവയും പൂർണ്ണമായും exempt ആണ്.

beats.voice_sync_text: അവസാനമായി നമുക്ക് നോക്കാം: Section 10(1) പ്രകാരം agricultural income exempt ആണ്, എന്നാൽ residential rent chargeable ആണ്, nursery seedlings exempt ആണ്, ഒപ്പം Sikkimese income ഉം exempt ആണ്.
